abstract: INTRODUCTION: We evaluated the immunohistochemical expression of p53, Ki67, CD30, and CD117 and correlated it with histological features and presence of clinical metastasis at diagnosis of testicular seminomas. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A retrospective study of 62 patients was performed in patients with pure seminoma. The retroperitoneum was staged with computed tomography scan and the thorax with simple x-rays and/or computed tomography scan. Pathologists were unaware of the clinical stage of the patients. Manual microarrays were created from a tissue representative of tumor. The expression of p53, Ki67, CD30, and CD117 was evaluated as negative, any degree of expression, and expression in more than 50% of neoplastic cells. Univariate and multivariate analysis were performed. RESULTS: Sixty-two cases were analyzed: 43 cases were in clinical stage I (69.4%), 17 were in clinical stage II (27.4%), and 2 were in clinical stage III (3.2%). Fifty-six cases expressed CD117 (90%), 42 p53 (68%), 8 CD30 (13%), and all cases Ki67. There were no differences in p53, Ki67, CD30, and CD117 expression between testicular seminoma with and without clinical metastasis at diagnosis, regardless of the magnitude of expression. Neither of them found positive association between these marker expressions and morphologic risk factors such as tumor size greater than 6 cm and rete testis invasion. CONCLUSIONS: This study shows that expression of p53, Ki67, and CD30 and loss of CD117 expression fail to predict the presence of clinical metastasis at diagnosis of testicular seminoma and do not correlate with other histopathological risk factors in clinical stage I patients.
abstract_ja:
はじめに：
精巣セミノーマにおけるp53、Ki67、CD30、CD117の免疫組織化学的発現を評価し、組織学的特徴および診断時の臨床的転移の有無との相関を検討した。
材料と方法：
純粋なセミノーマの患者62例を対象とした後方視的研究を実施した。後腹膜はCTで病期診断を行い、胸部は単純X線および/またはCTで評価した。病理医は患者の臨床病期を知らされていなかった。腫瘍を代表する組織から手作業で組織マイクロアレイを作製した。p53、Ki67、CD30、CD117の発現を、陰性、いずれかの程度の発現、腫瘍細胞の50%超での発現の3段階で評価した。単変量解析および多変量解析を実施した。
結果：
62例を解析した：臨床病期Iが43例(69.4%)、病期IIが17例(27.4%)、病期IIIが2例(3.2%)であった。56例がCD117陽性(90%)、42例がp53陽性(68%)、8例がCD30陽性(13%)、全例がKi67陽性であった。p53、Ki67、CD30、CD117の発現は、診断時の臨床的転移の有無で、発現の程度にかかわらず差はなかった。いずれのマーカーも、腫瘍径6cm超や精巣網浸潤といった形態学的リスク因子と正の相関を示さなかった。
結論：
本研究は、p53、Ki67、CD30の発現およびCD117発現の消失が、精巣セミノーマの診断時の臨床的転移の有無を予測できず、臨床病期Iの患者において他の病理学的リスク因子とも相関しないことを示している。
